description.en: Reconstructive recall enhancer for DeepSeek Harness: reads the memory stores of existing memory plugins (16 built-in adapters incl. dsh-prime-memory, dsh-mnemon, dsh-loci, dsh-memory-palace), fuses multiple stores with RRF in auto mode, and before each model step rebuilds retrieved memory fragments into contextual, emotionally-toned recollection snippets instead of raw-text injection. Ships a Memory Sea visualization panel that projects memories as a deep-space point cloud (dots are memories, lines are associations) with one-click switching between raw and consolidated sources, plus a 2D/3D toggle with an orbital camera and live shape parameters (thickness, idle auto-rotate, perspective strength).
description.zh: 重建式回忆增强插件:只读现有记忆插件的记忆库(内置 16 种主流记忆源适配,含 dsh-prime-memory、dsh-mnemon、dsh-loci、dsh-memory-palace 等),auto 模式下多库 RRF 融合,在模型步骤前把检索到的记忆碎片「重建」为带语境与情绪的回忆片段注入,替代生硬的原文注入。附带「记忆识海」可视化面板:把记忆画成深空点云(点是记忆、线是联想),原始记忆 / 巩固记忆双数据源一键切换,并支持 2D/3D 双视角(轨道相机 + 厚度 / 自转 / 透视强度实时可调)。
